blocks: Whole map is expressed in REGISTER numbers; the wire address is register − 1 ("The main Classic address map starts at register 4101 but the packet itself sends out address 4100"). 4101–4144 identity, MAC, real-time values · 4145–4230 setpoints, Aux 1/2 config, MPPT mode · 4231–4384 internals, logs index, Whizbang Jr · 10001–10064 comm statistics (4 bus interfaces) · 16385–16390 firmware/net versions · 20481–20493 network config + Ethernet write-unlock · 28673–28674 serial number (read over RS-232) · 61441–61442 reserved. Log retrieval uses MidNite's own function codes 0x68 (104, Read Internal) and 0x69 (105, Write Internal), not the standard Modbus 0x14/0x15 file transfer.

gotchas: This is Modbus framing but NOT RS-485. The primary transport is Modbus TCP over 10/100 Ethernet; the secondary is Modbus over an RJ-11 RS-232 jack. There is no RS-485 port on a Classic. Rev C.4 --- Dec 9, 2013". Rev C5/Dec 8 vs Rev C.4/Dec 9. Cite it by the URL, not by a revision number.

Register vs. address off-by-one, stated by the vendor: "The main Classic address map starts at register 4101 but the packet itself sends out address 4100." Both cross-checked implementations subtract one. A driver that sends 4101 on the wire reads the software build year where it expects the PCB revision — every value

unmappedReports: state-of-charge — the Classic shows SoC on the MNGP when a Whizbang Jr shunt is fitted, but Rev C.4 has NO SoC register: 4247 EndingSoc, 4250 BattMonVolts, 4251 BattMonSOC are all annotated "Future SOC use", and 4373–4384 are "Reserved". ClassicMQTT reads 4373 as SOC, 4377 as RemainingAmpHours and 4381 as TotalAmpHours — all inside that reserved block. See gotchas; do not treat those three addresses as vendor-backed., Charge-stage timers — 4139/4154 Absorb time, 4138 FloatTimeTodaySeconds, 4143/4162 Equalize time remaining. No MetricKind expresses "seconds left in this stage", which is exactly what tells you whether a bank actually finished absorb., Open-circuit PV voltage — 4122 VocLastMeasured and 4231 VocRD. Distinct from pv-voltage and useful for array-fault detection; no MetricKind., Daily / lifetime amp-hour throughput — 4125 AmpHours (daily), 4128/4129 LifetimeAmpHours. consumed-amp-hours is the only Ah metric and means something else (net drawn from the bank)., Highest PV input voltage ever seen — 4123 HighestVinputLog. The single number that tells you whether a string is over-VOC in cold weather; no MetricKind., MPPT operating mode — 4164, Table 4164-1: PV U-Set / Dynamic / Wind Track / Legacy P&O / Solar / Hydro. The Classic is a wind and micro-hydro controller too; there is no MetricKind or DeviceKind that carries that., Reason-for-resting diagnostic code — 4275, Table 4275-1, 30+ enumerated causes (ground fault, arc fault, HyperVOC, FET over-temp, low light, battery under 8.0 V, …). This is the richest fault channel on the device and there is no fault/alarm MetricKind at all; clear-fault exists as a command with nothing to read back., Fault and condition flags — 4130/4131 Table 4130-1: GroundFaultF, ArcFaultF, OCP, HyperVoc, Current Limit, LowBatteryVF, NegBatCurrentF, TempCompShortedF, PvPartialShadeF. Same gap as above., Two distinct internal temperatures — 4133 FETtemperature and 4134 PCBTemperature both have to collapse onto the single `temperature` MetricKind; one of them has to be dropped or renamed by the driver., Whizbang Jr shunt temperature — 4372 LSB, °C − 50. A third temperature with nowhere to go., PWM duty cycle — 4141 PWM_ReadOnly, 0–1023 ("NOT Percent")., Minutes at night with no power — 4135 NiteMinutesNoPwr., Communication health — 10001–10064 rx_ok / rx_crc_err / dropped_busy per bus interface. Useful for deciding whether a flaky reading is the controller or the cable; no MetricKind.
